description: Modified Condition/Decision Coverage: Every condition in a decision must be shown to independently affect the outcome of the decision, and every entry point and every point of exit must be invoked at least once.
pass_criteria: 100% of conditions independently affect decision outcomes; 100% of decision outcomes (True and False) taken; 100% of statements executed

description: Decision Coverage: Every decision in the program must have taken all possible outcomes (True and False) at least once, and every entry point and exit point must be invoked at least once.
pass_criteria: 100% of decision outcomes (True and False) taken; 100% of statements executed

description: Statement Coverage: Every statement in the program must have been invoked at least once.
Statement Coverage: Every statement in the program must have been invoked at least once.
